maria_csm: Kicking off Sundial Health onboarding (Redwood Private in their AWS VPC). Goal: go-live in ~8w. Need owners, success metrics, timeline, blockers. Customer contacts: Priya (PM), Dan (Security). Proposed owners: Maria (CSM), Alex (SE), Joanne (Platform), Ken (Ops), Sam (Enablement), Ruth (Program). Thoughts?

maria_csm: Suggested success criteria: private endpoints validated; SAML SSO + provisioning working; PHI field mapping signed off; demo flows p50 <250ms for 95%; runbook + training delivered.

alex_se: I own SE integration (model mapping, API contract, tests). Need sample payloads + SAML metadata from Priya. Will ship checklist by EOW.

sam_cs: Enablement will run two 90min sessions (devs + ops), quickstart doc + recording, and a basic metrics dashboard (uptime, p50/p95, errors).

joanne_eng: Ill run VPC/network validation and draft autoscale/batching config. Q: expected pilot RPS?

maria_csm: Priya estimates ~50 RPS pilot, ~200 RPS steady. Ill confirm.

ken_ops: Ill handle certs and KMS. If customer supplies keys, certs take 3-5 business days; HSM adds ~1 week. Need SOC2/BAA asks.

ruth_pm: Ill drive timeline. Proposal: Week0 kickoff; W1-2 infra; W3-4 integration; W5 pilot; W6-7 iterate; W8 go-live + 30d health check. Canary: 10% for 72h with automated fallback.

maria_csm: Major risks: SAML metadata delay, unclear PHI schema, cert/KMS lag, legal docs.

maria_csm: Actions: Maria confirm RPS + request SAML/payloads (Tue); Alex checklist (EOW); Joanne network + autoscale draft (mid next week); Ken cert/KMS runbook + doc list (Wed); Sam training dates (Thu/Fri next week); Ruth canary config + rollback playbook (Wed).

maria_csm: @onboardbot please schedule 60m kickoff Tues 11am PT and add link.

onboardbot: Meeting scheduled: Tue 11:00 AM PT  60m  "Sundial Health  Redwood Private Onboarding Kickoff" Join: https://meet.example.com/abcd1234 (invites sent).

alex_se: :thumbsup: blocking time.

sam_cs: +1 will prep agenda.

ruth_pm: Ill create the project board and add these tasks.

maria_csm: Thanks all  Ill update thread with artifacts from Sundial. Flag blockers here or DM me. :rocket:
